dashboard.title: Enterprise Dashboard

business.forbiddenDescription: You do not have permission to see this, or it does not exist.
business.comingSoonDescription: This section of {business} is being built.

account.passwordDescription: After the change, this device stays signed in and every other device is signed out.
account.rules: 10 to 128 characters, not your email or phone number.
account.success: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
account.sameAsIdentity: The password cannot be your email or phone number.

settings.title: Settings
settings.nothingDescription: Your role can open Settings, but no section is available to it yet.
settings.readOnly: View only: only the platform owner can make changes here.
settings.loadError: The data could not be loaded.

roles.intro: Tick what each role may do in this business. Changes apply as soon as they are saved.
roles.lockedReason: The owner role always has every permission and cannot be changed.
roles.ownerOnlyReason: Only the platform owner has this; it cannot be given to any role.
roles.changeCount: {count, plural, =0 {No unsaved changes} one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}

failureReason.refused: the server refused it (for example an owner-only permission)

roles.leaveBody: Your permission changes have not been saved and will be lost.

users.name: Name
users.emptyDescription: Users you add will appear here.

create.title: New user
create.passwordHint: 10 to 128 characters, not the user’s email or phone. Tell the user safely.
create.contactRequired: Enter an email or a phone number.
create.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid Bangladeshi mobile number.

resetDialog.title: Reset password of {name}
resetDialog.intro: Set a new password and tell it to the user safely. All their devices will be signed out.
resetDialog.success: Password of {name} was reset. All their other devices have been signed out.

confirmDeactivate.title: Deactivate {name}?
confirmDeactivate.body: They will be signed out at once and cannot sign in to any business until activated again.

confirmActivate.title: Activate {name}?
confirmActivate.body: They will be able to sign in again.

confirmRemove.title: Remove {name} from this business?
confirmRemove.body: Their account is not deleted; they just cannot open this business any more (immediately).

error.noPermission: You no longer have permission to do this.
error.notFound: This user was not found; the list has been refreshed.
